page.overview:
What is Yu-Gi-Oh! Go Rush!!?

Yu-Gi-Oh! GO RUSH!! is the eighth Yu-Gi-Oh! anime series succeeding Yu-Gi-Oh! SEVENS, and the seventh main spin-off series that premiered in Japan on April 3rd, 2022 and ended on March 30, 2025.

An English dub premiered on Disney XD on January 11, 2025.

Like SEVENS, it focuses on Rush Duel. It also introduces a new type of monster, the Galaxy Type, including Equip Spell Cards, Contact Fusion, and Ritual Summon.

The story takes place as an interquel to Yu-Gi-Oh! SEVENS taking place approximately 150-to-250 years before SEVENS and also later on directly concerning the time period after what's shown in SEVENS.
